title: Sweet Water
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A new 2nd-level spell for clerics, druids and rangers of water: Sweet Water calls up a draught of clean water that heals 1d4 + 1 per two levels and ends poison and disease. With the Defiling mod, it can also be cast at a defiler's ash, or at someone standing in it, to bring the ground within a cell back to life. It uses Cure Light Wounds' icon and look. Off: the game has only the original's spells.
